segments: ... one of the counts who were with them.
And the Franks remained in it for thirteen days, while finding nothing to eat;
and many ate their horses.
And when Sultan Barkiyaruq heard,
he sent a hundred thousand horsemen to Antioch,
and they came and encamped against Baghras.
And one of the kings of the Franks saw a dream,
and they opened a place in the church of Qosiana (of Mar Cassian?):
and they found there nails of the Cross of our Lord {OCR: the Holy Lance / nails of the cross?};
and from them they made a cross and a spearhead.
And they took them,
and went out against the Turks.
And God gave victory to the Franks,
and they filled the earth with the slain.
And they came and encamped against the city of Ma'arra,
and took control of it.
And they killed more than a hundred thousand souls in it,
and took great plunder, after they had remained in it for forty days.
And from there they went to Mount Lebanon,
and killed in it a great multitude of people,
of those who are called Nusayris.
And they came and encamped against Arqa, which is near Tripoli,
and made war against it for four months,
but were not able to capture it.
And they left it and went to Shayzar,
and Ibn Munqidh, the Arab ruler who was in it, submitted to them,
and gave them tribute, and they left him.
And they went against Hims,
and Janah al-Dawla, who was there,
also came out to them and became subject to them.
And they left him and went to Jerusalem,
and fought against it for more than forty days.
And there was a leader there, a man from the region of the Egyptians, whose name was Iftikhar al-Dawla.
And the Franks set up two towers of wood:
one on the southern side, in the place called Zion,
and the other opposite the eastern gate,
that of Saint Stephen.
And when the Arabs threw fire at the one on Zion,
and before the conflagration was completed,
a cry went up
that the Franks had entered from the eastern side.
And they put people to the sword for a week of days,
and killed more than seventy thousand Arabs in the Temple of Solomon.
And they took from near the Rock (Sakhra) forty lamps of silver,
each lamp weighing three thousand six hundred dirhams,
and another one hundred and fifty small lamps,
twenty of them of Egyptian gold.
And they also took the column that Jacob set up in Bethel {OCR?},
and the place of worship where silver was placed {OCR?}...
